== Printed wording comparison ==
The original Virtual Set #1a sheet and this later complete face use different printed wording. The deployment timing/frequency wording changed; the difference is not confined to print resolution or an expanded icon.<ref>Players Committee, [https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualCards1a.pdf Virtual Set #1a], complete original sheet; [[:File:Holotable-OVS1-Blaster-Rack-v17.gif|later complete card face]].</ref> The comparison establishes different printed wording; it does not establish a same-word predecessor for the Remastered date field. The existing edition name and the Released bound for this later carrier are retained.
